explication: Crisp is a native macOS menu-bar app for external-display controls. The main workflow starts in the panel or an automation, reaches display-management services, and applies changes to display modes, brightness, color, connections, or other monitor settings. Presets coordinate multi-display changes; crispctl and Shortcuts expose automation entry points. The graph follows README capabilities and the supplied source index; several feature implementations were not excerpted, so their internal links are omitted where evidence is unavailable.
